title: Cobblemon: Gem Cutting!
description: Ever thought the type gems were too hard to find? Then craft and cut them yourself!
body:
Have you ever wanted a certain gem, but no matter how hard you explore, you just can't find any? Well look no further! With this datapack, you can craft a Normal Type Gem, and then stonecut it into the other Gem types!

Base:
Normal Crafting, Stonecut into any gem, but cannot cut into other gems [Ex: Water -x> Dragon]

Expanded (Coming Soon)
Normal Crafting, Stonecut any gem type into any gem type.
